purpose: Controlled positional defensive replay; no policy tuning or free-match outcome claim
window: Transitions: entire existing interval. Shots: through shot onset, restricted to the final continuous opponent-possession run. No bridging own-possession intervals.
initialization: Second complete sample; initial velocity uses the preceding sample only. Stable shirt-to-slot mapping, keeper fixed to slot 1. No actual body orientation is observed.
subgroups: Disjoint fixed identities: two initially nearest to ball; four deepest remaining; four remaining
exogenous: Ball, ten attackers and both goalkeepers prescribed; only ten defending outfield players integrate engine movement
contact: Shadow replay: no capture, tackle, scoring, free attacking decision, aerial reconstruction or anticipation from a private pass endpoint
missingData: Exclude incomplete/gapped intervals; never reconstruct missing actors or ball
acceptance: Harness integrity and complete results including adverse comparisons. No production policy accepted from trajectory error or imposed outcomes. These previously analysed clips are development, not held out.
